defense_news.title: US Air Force awards $2.38B contract to Boeing for 22 F-15EX
defense_news.summary: The service awarded Boeing a contract for 22 more F-15EX aircraft, bringing the number to a total of 120 to be manufactured by the defense company.

defense_news.title: White House nominates next general to helm US Space Command
defense_news.summary: If confirmed, Lt. Gen. David N. Miller Jr. would take over command from Gen. Stephen Whiting after his upcoming retirement.

defense_news.title: Operation Atlantic City ushers Marines on rare trip to ... remote Arctic island
defense_news.summary: U.S. Marines participated in a NATO exercise on a remote Arctic island as the alliance increases its focus on the region amid worries about Russia.

defense_news.title: US Army selects five companies for PrSM development
defense_news.summary: The Army on Tuesday signed agreements with Anduril, Castelion, Lockheed Martin, Mach Industries and RTX to create advanced long-range missile prototypes.
